Amber D

تقييم 3

It was just…ok. As someone who gets their hair done very infrequently as a SAHM I was hoping for a bit more warmth and a good yap but found Shelbie to be a little cold on arrival. A few comments were made on my hairs “fluffiness” and “thinness” that made me a bit self conscious. Haircut and colour was very basic and I feel the charge is too high for something that was very straightforward (global colour, straight across cut because my hair is “too thin”) all in all it was just ok, not good enough to return sadly.

تم الرد منذ 2 يوم/أيام

Hi Amber, Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We're really sorry your experience wasn't what you had hoped for, especially when getting your hair done is something you don't get to do very often. We want every client to feel welcomed, comfortable and valued. We're particularly sorry that some of the comments about your hair left you feeling self-conscious. While consultations are important, we always want this to be communicated in a positive and supportive way. We also appreciate your feedback regarding the service and pricing. We're disappointed we missed the mark and will be discussing your feedback with our team to ensure we continue improving. Thank you again for your honesty, and we're sorry we didn't deliver the experience you deserved. Warm regards, Koha the Salon Management Team
